chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, surely has mercy on a man because of the intensity of his love for his child.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the Exalted, who bestows mercy
key_terms.حُبِّهِ: his love; the man's deep affection
key_terms.شِدَّةِ: intensity or strength; emphasizing the depth of feeling
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: the Mighty and Majestic; an honorific expressing Allah's greatness
key_terms.لَيَرْحَمُ: surely has mercy; indicates divine compassion and favor
key_terms.وَلَدِهِ: his child; the object of parental love

ai.seo_question: How can a father's love for his child become a cause of Allah's mercy?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that sincere and intense love of a parent for his child is a cause for divine mercy. It highlights the moral and spiritual value of natural parental affection within family life.
